action.text: A person mantles onto a {ledge} ledge,

contact.text: planting {hands} on the top surface, palms down and fingers forward.

transition.text: Keep the supporting palms fixed while pulling and pushing the body up, then release the hands and finish standing with both feet on the ledge.

cautious.text: The person moves cautiously, with deliberate weight shifts and a controlled rise.

light.text: The person moves lightly and confidently, with fluid weight shifts and a brisk rise.
